verdict.rationale: Portkey is an AI gateway and observability platform, not itself an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The only MCP evidence (portkey-docs-17) describes the gateway connecting to remote MCP servers, which is client-side functionality. Nothing in the pack shows a first-party Portkey MCP server that an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
